title: lane r9 SE: new-at-HEAD must-pass over-fires on non-executed tests
description: Lane round 9. Lens: SE (validator: SO). Defect: a quarantine ignore test or a relocated pre-existing ignored test is new-at-HEAD and does not execute-pass — the constraint blocks the exact relocation lane it serves, contradicting the pin doctrine's skipped-is-neither vocabulary in the same bullet; over-firing buys nothing since only failing new tests are the laundering vector. Citations verified: contract:64, :173, :180. Proposed: resolved-candidate (restate: no new-at-HEAD test may fail, skipped is neither; relocated-ignored fixture seeded).
